```{r}
# install packages 
library(tidyverse)
library(DataExplorer)
library(stringdist)
library(janitor)
library(dplyr)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# EDA - Motor Insurance Claims
# Dataset: cleaned_claims
# ============================================================

library(tidyverse)
library(corrplot)

book26 = read.csv("book26.csv", header = TRUE)
claims <- book26

# ============================================================
# 1. Basic overview
# ============================================================

dim(claims)
str(claims)
summary(claims)

# Number of unique policies
n_distinct(claims$PolicyID)

# Overall claims experience
claims %>%
  summarise(
    Observations = n(),
    TotalClaims = sum(ClaimNb),
    TotalClaimCost = sum(ClaimAmount),
    ClaimFrequency = mean(ClaimNb),
    ClaimRate = mean(ClaimNb > 0),
    AverageClaimCost = sum(ClaimAmount) / sum(ClaimNb),
    PurePremium = mean(ClaimAmount)
  )


# ============================================================
# 2. Distribution of numerical variables
# ============================================================

# Driver age
ggplot(claims, aes(x = DriverAge)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 60) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Driver Age",
    x = "Driver Age",
    y = "Number of Policies"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggplot(claims, aes(x = DriverAge)) +
  geom_histogram(
    aes(y = after_stat(density)),
    binwidth = 1,
    fill = "lightblue",
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_density(colour = "pink") +
  labs(title = "Driver Age Distribution", x = "Driver Age", y = "Density") +
  theme_minimal()
# Years licensed
ggplot(claims, aes(x = YearsLicensed)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Years Licensed",
    x = "Years Licensed",
    y = "Number of Policies"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# Vehicle age
# Distribution of vehicle age

vehicle_age_counts <- claims %>%
  count(VehAge) %>%
  arrange(VehAge)

ggplot(vehicle_age_counts, aes(x = VehAge, y = n)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(
      min(vehicle_age_counts$VehAge),
      max(vehicle_age_counts$VehAge),
      by = 1
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Vehicle Age",
    x = "Vehicle Age (years)",
    y = "Number of Policies"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# Vehicle value
ggplot(claims, aes(x = VehValue)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Vehicle Value",
    x = "Vehicle Value ($)",
    y = "Number of Policies"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# Density
ggplot(claims, aes(x = Density)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Population Density",
    x = "Density (people/km²)",
    y = "Number of Policies"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()


# ============================================================
# 3. Distribution of categorical variables
# ============================================================

# Vehicle type
ggplot(claims, aes(x = VehicleType)) +
  geom_bar() +
  labs(
    title = "Policies by Vehicle Type",
    x = "Vehicle Type",
    y = "Number of Policies"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# Risk zone
ggplot(claims, aes(x = RiskZone)) +
  geom_bar() +
  labs(
    title = "Policies by Risk Zone",
    x = "Risk Zone",
    y = "Number of Policies"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# Annual kilometres
ggplot(claims, aes(x = AnnualKms)) +
  geom_bar() +
  labs(
    title = "Policies by Annual Kilometres",
    x = "Annual Kilometres",
    y = "Number of Policies"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# Garaging location
ggplot(claims, aes(x = GaragingLocation)) +
  geom_bar() +
  labs(
    title = "Policies by Garaging Location",
    x = "Garaging Location",
    y = "Number of Policies"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# Vehicle use
ggplot(claims, aes(x = VehicleUse)) +
  geom_bar() +
  labs(
    title = "Policies by Vehicle Use",
    x = "Vehicle Use",
    y = "Number of Policies"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# Payment frequency
ggplot(claims, aes(x = PaymentFrequency)) +
  geom_bar() +
  labs(
    title = "Policies by Payment Frequency",
    x = "Payment Frequency",
    y = "Number of Policies"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()


# ============================================================
# 4. Claim count distribution
# ============================================================

claims %>%
  count(ClaimNb) %>%
  mutate(Percentage = n / sum(n) * 100)

ggplot(claims, aes(x = ClaimNb)) +
  geom_bar() +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Number of Claims",
    x = "Number of Claims",
    y = "Number of Policy-Years"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()


# ============================================================
# 5. Claim amount distribution
# ============================================================

# All observations
ggplot(claims, aes(x = ClaimAmount)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Claim Amount",
    x = "Claim Amount ($)",
    y = "Number of Policy-Years"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# Positive claims only
ggplot(
  claims %>% filter(ClaimAmount > 0),
  aes(x = ClaimAmount)
) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Positive Claim Amounts",
    x = "Claim Amount ($)",
    y = "Number of Claims"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# Log claim amount
ggplot(
  claims %>% filter(ClaimAmount > 0),
  aes(x = log(ClaimAmount))
) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50) +
  labs(
    title = "Log Distribution of Positive Claim Amounts",
    x = "Log Claim Amount",
    y = "Number of Claims"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()


# ============================================================
# 6. Claim frequency by risk factors
# ============================================================

# Driver age
claims %>%
  group_by(DriverAge) %>%
  summarise(
    Policies = n(),
    Claims = sum(ClaimNb),
    Frequency = mean(ClaimNb),
    ClaimRate = mean(ClaimNb > 0),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = DriverAge, y = Frequency)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    title = "Claim Frequency by Driver Age",
    x = "Driver Age",
    y = "Average Number of Claims"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# Vehicle type
claims %>%
  group_by(VehicleType) %>%
  summarise(
    Policies = n(),
    Claims = sum(ClaimNb),
    Frequency = mean(ClaimNb),

  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "Claim Frequency by Vehicle Type",
    x = "Vehicle Type",
    y = "Claim Frequency"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# Risk zone

  geom_col() +
  labs(

  ) +
  theme_minimal()

claims %>%

    Frequency = mean(ClaimNb),

  ) %>%

  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# Payment frequency
claims %>%
  group_by(PaymentFrequency) %>%
  summarise(
    Frequency = mean(ClaimNb),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = PaymentFrequency, y = Frequency)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "Claim Frequency by Payment Frequency",
    x = "Payment Frequency",
    y = "Claim Frequency"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# NCD level
claims %>%
  group_by(NCDLevel) %>%
  summarise(
    Frequency = mean(ClaimNb),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = NCDLevel, y = Frequency)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "Claim Frequency by NCD Level",

# ============================================================
# 8. Pure premium by risk factors
# ============================================================

# Vehicle type
claims %>%
  group_by(VehicleType) %>%
  summarise(
    Frequency = mean(ClaimNb),
    Severity = sum(ClaimAmount) / sum(ClaimNb),
    PurePremium = mean(ClaimAmount),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Risk zone
claims %>%
  group_by(RiskZone) %>%
  summarise(
    Frequency = mean(ClaimNb),
    Severity = sum(ClaimAmount) / sum(ClaimNb),
    PurePremium = mean(ClaimAmount),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Payment frequency
claims %>%
  group_by(PaymentFrequency) %>%
  summarise(
    Frequency = mean(ClaimNb),
    Severity = sum(ClaimAmount) / sum(ClaimNb),
    PurePremium = mean(ClaimAmount),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Pure premium by risk zone
claims %>%
  group_by(RiskZone) %>%
  summarise(
    PurePremium = mean(ClaimAmount),
    .groups = "drop"

  ggplot(aes(x = RiskZone, y = PurePremium)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "Pure Premium by Risk Zone",

  ) +

# ============================================================
# 9. Numerical relationships
# ============================================================

numeric_vars <- dplyr::select(
    claims,
    DriverAge,
    YearsLicensed,
    VehAge,
    VehValue,
    Density,
    ExcessChosen,
    NCDLevel,
    TenureYears,
    ClaimNb,
    ClaimAmount
  )

cor_matrix <- cor(
  numeric_vars,
  use = "complete.obs"
)

round(cor_matrix, 2)

corrplot(
  cor_matrix,
  method = "color",
  type = "upper",
  addCoef.col = "black",
  tl.col = "black",
  number.cex = 0.7
)

# Driver age vs claim amount
ggplot(

) +

    title = "Driver Age and Claim Amount",

    y = "Claim Amount ($)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# Vehicle value vs claim amount
ggplot(
  claims %>% filter(ClaimAmount > 0),

) +

ggplot(

risk_summary
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# VIOLIN PLOTS
# ============================================================

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Variables measured in years
# DriverAge, YearsLicensed, VehAge, TenureYears
# ------------------------------------------------------------

claims %>%
  dplyr::select(
    DriverAge,
    YearsLicensed,
    VehAge,
    TenureYears
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = everything(),
    names_to = "Variable",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Variable, y = Value)) +
  geom_violin() +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Age and Tenure Variables",
    x = "Variable",
    y = "Years"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Vehicle value
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ggplot(claims, aes(x = "", y = VehValue)) +
  geom_violin() +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Vehicle Value",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Vehicle Value ($)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Population density
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ggplot(claims, aes(x = "", y = Density)) +
  geom_violin() +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Population Density",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Density (people/km²)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Claim amount
# Positive claims only
# ------------------------------------------------------------

ggplot(
  claims %>% filter(ClaimAmount > 0),
  aes(x = "", y = ClaimAmount)
) +
  geom_violin() +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Positive Claim Amounts",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Claim Amount ($)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
#Claim Frequency Stats
cleaned_claims %>%
  summarise(
    MeanClaimNb = mean(ClaimNb),
    VarianceClaimNb = var(ClaimNb),
    SDClaimNb = sd(ClaimNb),
    ClaimFrequency = mean(ClaimNb > 0)
  )

# Positive Claim Severity
claim_amount_distribution <- cleaned_claims %>%
  filter(ClaimAmount > 0) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    Mean = mean(ClaimAmount),
    Median = median(ClaimAmount),
    SD = sd(ClaimAmount),
    Min = min(ClaimAmount),
    Q1 = quantile(ClaimAmount, 0.25),
    Q3 = quantile(ClaimAmount, 0.75),
    Max = max(ClaimAmount)
  )

claim_amount_distribution
#Claim Frequency Number
cleaned_claims %>%
  summarise(
    MeanClaimNb = mean(ClaimNb),
    TotalClaims = sum(ClaimNb),
    TotalExposure = sum(Exposure),
    ClaimFrequency = sum(ClaimNb) / sum(Exposure),
    VarianceClaimNb = var(ClaimNb)
  )
```

```{r}
# Coloured Graphs for Severity
# Average claim severity by Vehicle Type
cleaned_claims %>%
  filter(ClaimNb > 0) %>%
  group_by(VehicleType) %>%
  summarise(
    AverageSeverity = sum(ClaimAmount) / sum(ClaimNb),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = VehicleType, y = AverageSeverity, fill = VehicleType)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "Average Claim Severity by Vehicle Type",
    x = "Vehicle Type",
    y = "Average Claim Severity"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# Average claim severity by Risk Zone
cleaned_claims %>%
  filter(ClaimNb > 0) %>%
  group_by(RiskZone) %>%
  summarise(
    AverageSeverity = sum(ClaimAmount) / sum(ClaimNb),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = RiskZone, y = AverageSeverity, fill = RiskZone)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(
    title = "Average Claim Severity by Risk Zone",
    x = "Risk Zone",
    y = "Average Claim Severity"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

```{r}
# Bivariate Heatmaps
# Shows how high annualKms in metro areas leads to higher claim frequency.

cleaned_claims %>%
  group_by(AnnualKms, RiskZone) %>%
  summarise(AvgClaimNb = mean(ClaimNb, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = AnnualKms, y = RiskZone, fill = AvgClaimNb)) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(AvgClaimNb, 2)), size = 3) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Average Claim Number") +
  labs(x = "Annual Kilometres", y = "Risk Zone",
       title = "Average Claim Number by Annual Kilometres and Risk Zone") +
  theme_minimal()

severity %>%
  group_by(AnnualKms, RiskZone) %>%
  summarise(AvgClaimSeverity = mean(AvgSeverity, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = AnnualKms, y = RiskZone, fill = AvgClaimSeverity)) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(AvgClaimSeverity, 2)), size = 3) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Average Claim Number") +
  labs(x = "Annual Kilometres", y = "Risk Zone",
       title = "Average Claim Number by Annual Kilometres and Risk Zone") +
  theme_minimal()
```
